claim_boundary: Qualification is build/test/source/custody evidence only. Performance, CPU/RSS improvement, native multi-host behavior, SSH-agent access, power-loss recovery and optimization exhaustion require separate observed evidence.

cross_report_receipts.publication_note: Hash downloaded original bytes independently; preserve original remote stat receipts as reported. Local copied-file inode/device/times are not the remote identity. Final SHA values must come from completed A50 originals, never an A48 or preparation receipt.

design: Create one isolated 168-file source from the actual ordinary six-stage A48 parent, overlay exactly the two reviewed existing files, then rerun format, fmt-check, package clean, strict clippy, the full test suite and release. The immutable A44/A46 functions retain per-stage gates, execution limits and original-child custody. This contract neither starts work nor classifies its result.

fresh_artifacts.body_readback_scope: The wrapper postcheck cross-checks compiler-event/copied-artifact/report bindings. Do not describe this as a separate postcheck body rehash. Any later actual test/release-body readback by the root or benchmark loader is a separate observed receipt.
fresh_artifacts.requirements: Exactly one matching hepta-runtime compiler-artifact per original test/release log; original_event.fresh is false, manifest_path equals source/Cargo.toml, target.src_path equals source/src/main.rs, profile.test is true only for test, executable remains under the fixed target. fresh_strictly_false=true; copied_artifact equals the corresponding qualification artifact, cached=false and copied path is the fixed qualification output. Its SHA is generated by the unchanged qualifier from the complete copied A50 body.

historical_a48_parent_scope.exact_boundary: A50 rereads actual A48 q/entry/worker, all six original logs and stage gates, source map/stat identities and the complete copied A48 release body. The historical A48 test ELF body is not read by this wrapper; its SHA/path/source are bound through the SHA-pinned ordinary parent report and exact fresh=false compiler event/cross-report proof. This preserves the original 128 MiB input-read budget. All current A50 stages, including full tests and release, must run anew.

original_worker_custody.identity_rules: pid is a positive original PID and equals actual_waitpid; original_identity.pid/pgrp/session equal pid. terminal_group_snapshot.errors/live are empty; exactly one original member has the same start_ticks/pgrp/session and a terminal Z/X/x state. Raw terminal status and final records are required; a tool launch acknowledgement is insufficient.

required_tests.duplicate_name_scope: The 19 required basenames are not the suite total or necessarily 19 unique fully qualified test instances. Three existing basenames occur under both archive_batch and usage_batch; the wrapper retains all matching success lines but only requires at least one per required name. Publish actual names/lines accurately.
required_tests.matching_rule: For each frozen required name, require at least one full line matching exact_python_pattern_prefix + re.escape(name) + exact_python_pattern_suffix. All matching lines are retained. No substring match, ignored result or failed line counts.
required_tests.requirements: required_test_coverage_verified=true; focused_reruns=0; overlay manifest SHA equals the frozen manifest; source_bundle identifies the retained original bundle; required_test_coverage.test_log equals strict_fresh_artifact_evidence.compiler_artifacts.test.log and actual unchanged full-test log receipt.

six_stage_success.requirements: Exactly six rows in both reports, same original protocol argv in order; returncode integer 0; worker executed=true, execution_count=1, timeout_seconds=1800, gate_clear=true; no row errors. Rehash each actual stage log against qualification log_sha256 and check each worker host_gate receipt.

source_custody.fixed_dependencies: entry.fixed_inputs_after and entry/worker.reused_dependencies_after retain the frozen tools/protocol/window/bundle identities; require reused_dependencies_unchanged=true.
source_custody.parent_before_after: entry.parent_source_before == entry.parent_source_after, including stat9 receipts; entry.parent_qualification == entry.parent_qualification_after; parent_unchanged_after_attempt=true.
source_custody.post_format_requirements: All three actual post-format maps must be equal and match a fresh complete source read. Inventory equals the input 168 paths. Only the two declared changed files may differ from the input map after formatting. Never assume input SHA is the tested SHA.

top_level_test_counting.rule: Use the actual raw test.log and match full test result summary lines. Sum only the three top-level harness summaries with filtered_out=0, confirming their harness context and expected row structure. Keep nested child summaries separately; existing two nested child runs have 1 passed and nonzero filtered_out and must not be added. Do not sum every line in qualification test results or derive suite counts from required_test_coverage. If structure/count differs, report the actual discrepancy; expected values are not a successful result.
